title: Celestin's band during her absence, 1935 to 1953
summary: She left in 1935 and rejoined in 1953. They discuss Celestin's wartime break, the Paddock period, Mercedes, and the musicians who stayed when she returned.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: It wasn't at the time that I was with them. As I said, I stopped in 35 and then I didn't rejoin until 53. So it might have been during that period.
During that time. But it wasn't… Although he was out of the music business too during the war. He was for a while. I remember too when he broke his leg and all.
And when he reorganized, well then I didn't become a member of his band at that time. I was still out. But I didn't rejoin until 53. Yes.
That's funny, he used Octave Crosby, I guess, when he went in the paddock. Well, that was the time, yes. Yes.
And Mercedes also. Well, Mercedes too. She was with him. I've never heard of her. Yeah, she's very, very good. She was with him during that period also.
That's right, I've heard that but I never did know her. Yes.
And these fellas who I'm with now were with him at that period. Yes. Howard French and…
Yes, I remember those days. I heard them then.
John Thomas and that bunch. Eddie Pearson who was dead. They were all with him during that period. Yes, I remember. That was before I came in. Yes. And then when I came in, they all remained.
